summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new AI Chat Assistant feature powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash. All chat endpoints working correctly with proper authentication. Frontend chat panel functional with slide-in animation, Markdown rendering, and proper integration. Minor overlay issue identified with send button clickability.

flaky_endpoints.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error when creating Stripe checkout session
flaky_endpoints.workaround: Unrelated to chat feature, legacy Stripe integration issue

ui_bugs.issue: Chat toggle button intercepts pointer events when trying to click send button inside chat panel
ui_bugs.symptoms: Send button click is blocked by chat toggle button overlay
ui_bugs.workaround: Button is functional but may require multiple clicks due to z-index issue

passed_tests: POST /api/chat/send returns 401 without authentication
GET /api/chat/history returns 401 without authentication
DELETE /api/chat/history returns 401 without authentication
GET /api/chat/suggestions returns 401 without authentication
POST /api/chat/send works with authentication and returns AI responses
POST /api/chat/send with 'Quel est le statut du systeme' returns health info (MongoDB, agent, orbit detected)
POST /api/chat/send with 'Montre-moi mes proprietes' returns property info (statut, sync, hotel detected)
GET /api/chat/history returns conversation history (10 messages found)
GET /api/chat/suggestions returns auto-suggestions with proper structure (2 suggestions found)
DELETE /api/chat/history properly clears chat history
Chat toggle button visible in bottom-right corner of dashboard
Clicking chat toggle opens slide-in panel from right side
Chat panel shows 'Assistant Orbit' header with 'Gemini 2.5 Flash' label
Chat input field and send button are present and functional
Chat suggestions display properly in the interface
Clear chat button accessible in chat panel header
All existing pages still accessible: Dashboard, Properties, Reservations, Console, Settings
Login with admin@orbit.io/admin123 credentials works correctly
Chat messages render with Markdown formatting support
Chat panel can be opened and closed with toggle button
Navigation sidebar remains fully functional with chat feature added
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix chat panel z-index/layering issue where chat toggle button intercepts pointer events for the send button inside the chat panel. Consider adjusting z-index values or button positioning to prevent overlay interference.
